programs.description: After he witnesses his entire family getting murdered over a video call, Surya decides to avenge their deaths. His fiancée, Gayathri, who is mourning the death of her brother, is ready to help him.
A pilot, who is falsely accused of murder, finds his deceased friend's sister masquerading as a nun. To clear his name, he must convince her to reveal the truth and testify on his behalf.
A fierce college rivalry turns deadly when one group embrace Satanism, unleashing terror by killing their rivals one by one.
Pappu falls in love with Rathi, who is older than him. However, things take a turn for the worse when a snake bites Rathi, and he is unable to ask for help due to their secret relationship.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Two bumbling brothers fall madly in love with a young female employee. However, hilarity ensues after they realise the woman nurtures a secret agenda.
Aravindan, a Chakyar Koothu artist from a village, gets married to Aswathy, who lives in a city. The whole village decides to accompany him to attend his marriage.
